description: Tourism By Region - Local Government Area Profiles is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Trade and Investment Commission - Tourism Research Australia (TRA). Tourism Research Australia’s Local Government Area Profiles assist industry and Government decision making and identify and support investment opportunities, particularly in regional Australia. Profiles are only prepared for Local Government Areas with adequate International Visitor Survey and/or National Visitor Survey sample to produce robust results. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-09. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
